title: Understanding SVD
text: The singular value decomposition (SVD) of a matrix X is given by X=U*S*V**T. Here, U and V are orthogonal matrices, and S is a diagonal matrix.

title: Properties of U, S, and V
text: In the SVD, the columns of U are the left singular vectors, the columns of V are the right singular vectors, and the diagonal entries of S are the singular values.

title: Eigenvectors and SVD
text: The columns of V (not U) are the eigenvectors of $$X^T X$$. The columns of U are the eigenvectors of $$X X^T$$.
